# Improvements and buildings

Every improvement in the current rules: tile improvements, buildings that grow with their neighbours, temples, monuments and the city itself. *Work* is the stars per level a level-based building pays each turn. *Max level* 0 means the improvement has no levels. *Pop* is the population it adds to the city that owns the tile, *score* the points it gives. Costs are in stars. *Hidden* improvements cannot be built from the menu.

## Placement and effects

*Built on*: any one of the listed terrains or resources. *Needs next to it*: any one of the listed neighbouring improvements or terrains. *Counts*: neighbours that raise its level. *Routes* are the terrains a network improvement connects over, up to *range* tiles. *Creates* is what the tile becomes. *Unlocked by* names the techs and tasks that make it buildable.
